onboarding.title: Create your first workspace
onboarding.description: You do not have access to any workspaces yet. Create one to open the application.

createDialog.description: Create a workspace for a separate product context.

createDialog.apiValidation: Check the workspace name and try again.

workspace.title: Workspace settings
workspace.description: Manage workspace identity and domain policy.

users.title: Workspace users
users.description: Review members and update built-in roles when permitted.

roles.title: Workspace roles
roles.description: Review the fixed role model for this workspace.

workspace.identityDescription: Update the workspace name, canonical slug, and allowed email domains.
workspace.dangerDescription: Permanently delete this workspace when another accessible workspace remains.

form.nameHint: Use 1–50 letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens, or underscores.
form.slugHint: Use lowercase letters and numbers separated by single hyphens.
form.domainsHint: Enter exact domains on separate lines or separated by commas. Leave empty to allow every domain.
form.readOnlyDescription: Only workspace administrators and owners can change these details.

validation.nameInvalid: Use 1–50 letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens, or underscores.
validation.slugInvalid: Use 1–64 lowercase letters or numbers separated by single hyphens.
validation.domainsInvalid: Enter valid exact email domains such as example.com.
validation.domainsTooMany: Use no more than 100 distinct email domains.

failures.validation: Check the workspace details and try again.
failures.concurrency: The workspace changed elsewhere. Review the current values and try again.
failures.generic: The workspace could not be updated.

deleteDialog.title: Delete workspace?
deleteDialog.description: This action cannot be undone. The workspace and its memberships will be permanently removed.
deleteDialog.confirmationHint: The name must match exactly, including capitalization.

failures.lastOrganization: Keep at least one accessible workspace.
failures.confirmationMismatch: Type the workspace name exactly as shown.
failures.permissionDenied: You no longer have permission to delete this workspace.
failures.concurrency: The workspace changed elsewhere. Review it and try again.
failures.generic: The workspace could not be deleted.

addMemberDialog.userIdInvalid: Enter an exact UUID user ID.
addMemberDialog.roleHint: Only roles you are allowed to assign are available.

failures.userNotFound: No existing account matches that user ID.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Owners can update settings, add members, assign every built-in role, and delete the workspace when another accessible workspace remains.

admin.title: Administrator
admin.summary: Workspace and member administration without ownership control.
admin.description: Administrators can update settings, add members, and assign Member or Administrator. They cannot assign or change Owner.

member.title: Member
member.description: Members can review safe workspace and directory details but cannot update settings, add members, change roles, or delete the workspace.

roles.fixedNotice: These three roles are fixed for this release. Custom roles are not available.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Create and open your accessible workspaces.
